ordinaryRun.explanation: Weighted log-distance/log-time regression changes slope/intercept and normalized weights after an ordinary training observation. Training pace is being treated as performance evidence, so a 9:29/mi run can move the fitted finish slower by approximately five seconds.

futurePlan.explanation: The real anchor ages by 56 days while 32 synthetic planned easy efforts have fresh weights. The fit moves toward easy training pace. This isolates the underlying legacy weighted fit; it is not the final anchored/consistency-wrapped Production chart.
